blocks.heading: WP Engine cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price WP Engine against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (infrastructure monitoring, log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Startup list price is first-year Essential annual packaging — renewal can change TCO. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

blocks.title: WP Engine cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Startup list price is first-year Essential annual packaging — renewal can change TCO

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: WordPress-specialist hosting — not Cloudways-style multi-app / multi-cloud VMs

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence for servers you already own

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Core list price and Enterprise quote are a different buying motion than Essential

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git-as-product, or a proxy network

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs WP Engine on identical constraints.
